title: Period, Frequency, and Angular Frequency Relationships
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating the relationships between period (T), frequency (f), and angular frequency (ω). Shows that T = 1/f and ω = 2πf.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: oscillations
waves
physics
frequency
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of period, frequency, and angular frequency relationships
Explore period, frequency, and angular frequency relationships through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of period, frequency, and angular frequency relationships to solve problems
Experiment with parameters to observe their effects on period, frequency, and angular frequency relationships
